facts.fact: The State Department for ICT and the Digital Economy's FY2026/27 guidelines treat the Government Enterprise Architecture and Government Interoperability Framework as existing whole-of-government frameworks that all MCDAs must institutionalise.

The guidelines require all ministries, counties, departments and agencies to institutionalise the GEA and GIF, submitting their enterprise architecture and systems and API inventory to the State Department for ICT and the Digital Economy and scored 40% each in the performance contract indicator.
